_about: Test rooms with centred connectors: the dungeon-generator shapes as 1x1 rooms, a 1x2 straight corridor and a 2x2 room.
Large_X has one opening per side, each on a different tile (a pinwheel), and is limited to one per dungeon.
No 'copies', so each room can be used any number of times.
Weights for the 1x1 rooms match dungeon-generator's defaults; Medium_I uses the same weight as I.
name: Test01
